headline: This change will fail: AWS RDS does not support enabling encryption on an existing unencrypted database in-place.

findings.evidence_ref: diff shows storage_encrypted: false → true on existing aws_db_instance.main
findings.explanation: AWS RDS does not allow encryption to be enabled on an already-provisioned, unencrypted database through modification. This Terraform apply will fail. Encryption must be added by restoring from a snapshot to a new encrypted instance, then migrating traffic.
